themes.title: Far-right AfD party congress sparks mass protests in Germany
themes.blurb: Germany's far-right AfD party held its congress in Erfurt, drawing massive protests with tens of thousands of demonstrators. The event saw re-election of party leaders Alice Weidel and Tino Chrupalla, while police clashed with protesters attempting to block the event. This theme reflects the intense cross-national resonance of far-right politics and opposition to it.

themes.title: Marine Le Pen's eligibility ruling dominates French politics
themes.blurb: France's far-right leader Marine Le Pen faces a pivotal court ruling on July 7 that could determine her eligibility for the 2027 presidential election. This decision has sparked intense political maneuvering within the Rassemblement National, with Jordan Bardella positioned as a potential replacement. The theme reflects the cross-national focus on far-right leadership dynamics in Europe.
